audience: developers, marketers and QA teams who need screenshots or text of web pages from ApiFlash

useCases.title: Capture a screenshot of a web page
useCases.text: The AI captures a public web page with headless Chrome and shows you the image. Each new capture uses one screenshot of your quota.

useCases.title: Capture a mobile-size or full-page screenshot
useCases.text: The AI sets the viewport size, the image format or full-page capture, so you can check how a page looks on a phone or in full length.

useCases.title: Capture a page without cookie banners and ads
useCases.text: The AI captures a page with ad, cookie-banner and tracker blocking, and can wait for a condition or capture only one element.

useCases.title: Read the text or HTML of a page
useCases.text: The AI loads a public page and returns its text, or its HTML, cut at 30,000 characters. Each new capture uses one screenshot of your quota.

useCases.title: Check how many screenshots are left
useCases.text: The AI reads your quota for the billing period: the limit, what remains and the reset time in UTC. This call does not use a screenshot.
